title: Security: BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN (admin-capable PAT) is exposed to 56 workflows; its scope is documented two ways
note: REPO READ 2026-11-11: the PAT is used by 56 of 166 workflows to sync branch protection, mint runner registration tokens (infra-runner-install.yml:51-59), write Actions secrets (init-actions-secrets, phone-executor-apk), open PRs and push to protected main. infra-runner-install.yml:7 says fine-grained Administration read+write; init-actions-secrets.yml:24-26 says classic repo scope. UNVERIFIED: the real scope and expiry (only visible in the operator's GitHub settings). Also gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4 (mutable tag, the only third-party action) runs in the job that holds the APK signing keys and this PAT (phone-executor-apk.yml:100-150). Proposed: one narrow token per job class, SHA-pin the gradle action, record scope and expiry in one place.
